title: Avomi CLIQ Mini Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill - Fizzy Cherry
description: Avomi’s Fizzy Cherry flavour combines sweet, ripe Cherry with a sparkling soda sensation for a fizzy finish. The bold fruit notes are lifted by the effervescent effect, creating a playful and satisfying vape. Designed for the Avomi CLIQ Mini Kit, this replacement pack utilises a unique hybrid system comprising a 2ml prefilled pod and a 4ml refill container. Together, they provide 6ml of premium Nicotine Salt e-liquid. The integrated mesh coil technology ensures rapid heating and consistent flavour production, delivering a smooth Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) draw that maximises the taste of the e-liquid. These prefilled pods eliminate the need for manual refilling or coil changes. Simply install the pod and container into your CLIQ Mini device to continue vaping. The 20mg Nicotine Salt formulation offers a smooth throat hit and quick nicotine satisfaction. Once the e-liquid is depleted, replace the entire pod and container unit with a fresh pack to ensure optimal performance. View the full range of Avomi CLIQ Mini Prefilled Pod Kits & Refills.
